title: gVisor: Container lifecycle, GVisorManager impl + test harness
description:
Implement gVisor container lifecycle and full GVisorManager + test harness from docs/plans/10-sandbox-gvisor.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §4.4 (container lifecycle — create/run/destroy), §4.5 (health + cleanup), §4.6 (runsc integration), test harness from docs/plans/10-sandbox-gvisor-test-harness.md

Key deliverables:
- GVisorManager implementation: Run(), CleanupStale(), ActiveContainers(), Close()
- Container lifecycle: create bundle dir → write OCI spec → invoke runsc create → runsc start → wait → capture output → destroy → cleanup
- runsc executor: command building, output/error capture, exit code extraction
- Health monitoring: detect hung containers, enforce timeouts via context cancellation
- CleanupStale: scan for orphaned containers/bundles, clean up, return count
- Close: cancel in-flight containers, wait for completion, mark manager closed
- Idempotent Close (ErrManagerClosed on subsequent Run calls)
- Test harness suites: P1-P5 (property), F1-F5 (fault injection), S1-S2 (stress), B1-B5 (benchmarks), SK1-SK3 (soak), SEC1-SEC7 (security), O1-O2 (observability)
- Unit tests for container lifecycle, cleanup, concurrent Run scenarios

Depends on: gVisor core types task for interface, types, OCI spec builder, cgroup translator.
